definitions.explanation: Negotiating or making a request directly with the person in charge, bypassing intermediaries or formal channels. Implies boldness or determination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直談判|じかだんぱん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went directly to the company president to negotiate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}さ→通す：02300_toosu⟧ず、⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直談判|じかだんぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It takes courage to go directly to the department head without going through your boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧、⟦{大家|おおや}さん→大家さん：26895_ooyasan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直談判|じかだんぱん}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to negotiate directly with the landlord to ask for a rent reduction.

notes:
USAGE:
The {直|じか} here is the same as in {直|じか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (directly, in person). This word carries a nuance of bypassing the usual process and going straight to someone with authority or responsibility. It can suggest boldness, resolve, or even slight impropriety depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直談判|じかだんぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to negotiate directly with ~
- {直談判|じかだんぱん}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go and negotiate in person
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直談判|じかだんぱん}: to go directly to the president
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}って→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧{直談判|じかだんぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take the plunge and negotiate directly
